scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend exec tsc --noEmit
